text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The day of the showdown is almost here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Sprinters Stakes—our current
goal—is still
half a year away. Was there
something else we
were supposed to be
working towards in the
meantime?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The Fan Fest, of course. Just the sound
of it is so
lovely... "Fan Fest."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fan interactions are the first step
towards
becoming official URA
merchandise.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Interactions are an opportunity for me to
get
closer to fans, and captivate their
hearts with my
loveliness.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's a crucial task that we have to get
done. We've
really got to work hard,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So, with that in mind, I want to hold a
session to
plan out what we're going to
do at the upcoming
Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking about it a lot. Since
it's the
Spring Fan Fest, there'll be
sports involved...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Three-legged races, catch, a thumb
wrestling
tournament, a ring toss
competition, bowling,
gateball...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We'll pick two of them and—actually,
doing all of
them is an option, too,
right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's clearly given this Fan Fest more
thought
than anyone. We make our
preparations one step
at a time...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now, at long last... today's the day!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I have a cold...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I was going to pretend like I was feeling
fine. But
Fuji stopped me...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sad I can't see any of my fans. But...
the last
thing I want is to get anyone
sick, so...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I'm going to rest... Sniff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's too bad she's under the weather, but
we can't
risk her condition getting any
worse.
choice_data_list: わかった、ゆっくり休んで

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Can I ask you to do
something?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Can I video call you and have you take
me
around the Fan Fest?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There might be some people there
who've come
to see me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I thought maybe I could talk with them
secretly,
just a little...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's right—given her recent
success,
people will probably be hoping
to meet her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After she promises not to wear herself
out, I
agree to stroll around the event
with my phone in
hand...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's get this fans-versus-fans
ball toss
contest started! Get yourselves
fired up,
everyone! Team Hishiama's
gonna win this for
sure!

text_block_list.name: Hishiama Fans
text_block_list.text: Yeahhh!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Okay, here we go! ♪ Whooo's the
cutest?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Fans
text_block_list.text: Curren Chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I search every corner of the event for
any fans
that might be looking for Aston
Machan...

text_block_list.name: Vodka Fan
text_block_list.text: Vodka! Have you fully recovered yet?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm doin' way better now! Sorry I
couldn't
race abroad for you guys.

text_block_list.name: Vodka Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaa!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet Fan A
text_block_list.text: Um... I wrote a letter for you, Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I just can't wait to see you race against
Vodka in
the autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wow, thank you very much! I'm so happy
to hear
that! I'll be sure to run my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There isn't a single person here
lamenting Aston
Machan's absence...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's actually baffling considering the
success she's
had. I must have missed the
people who were
looking for her...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: No... It's all right. Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We probably just walked past my fans
by
accident... And anyway, I'm sure they
would
rather talk to the racers who are
there in person.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'd feel the same if I was attending as a
fan. It's an
event where you can actually
meet Umamusume,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. I just haven't made much of a
mark.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best in the next race. ...So
don't worry
about it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for going out of your way to be
there for
me. I'm going to get some
sleep now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Enjoy the Fan Fest, Train—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's the sound of waves again...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean I'm almost there
already?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
By the way, are you going to stay at the
event?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't have anywhere to be... but I'd
feel a little
awkward enjoying the event
without her.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Um... It's probably just because I have a
cold, but
I'm feeling really lonely.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So... I'm going to come to your office.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll get dressed properly and bring a
blanket too,
so I can just stay on the
sofa.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ignoring my protests, she soon appears
at my
office, blanket in hand.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I brought a movie—it's a spy film I really
love.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's watch it together. It'll be really fun.
Yes?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm quite taken aback, but I don't say
anything to
give it away.
choice_data_list: （なんだか、いつもより懐いてくる）

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Thank you.
choice_data_list: わかった、一緒に観よう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We watch the fast-paced film while
cozied up in
my office.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, I like this part.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, I happen to hear the sound of
cheers
coming from outside.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Here we go—it's contest time! We've got
a duel here!
And it's between Vodka and
Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...They're getting very excited.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Next time for sure.
choice_data_list: ……次の感謝祭こそ、成功させよう
choice_data_list_en: ...Let's make sure the next Fan Fest is a success.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let's do it. There's always next time.
Next
time should be...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's the sound of waves again...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean I'm almost there
already?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...It's nothing.
